==Behavior==
Upon spawning, '''GOD-200''' will display a subtitle saying "𝐆𝐎𝐃 𝐈𝐒 𝐇𝐄𝐑𝐄.". Shortly after, '''GOD-200''' will rush to the main room at high speeds, emitting a speed-up version of [[SHA-200]]'s sound. Upon reaching the main room, '''GOD-200''' will kill all players, no matter if they are hidden or in a safe spot, as '''GOD-200'''<nowiki/>'s range can pass through objects and wall just like [[D-5i]]'s range.

== Strategy & tips ==
* There is nothing you can do if '''GOD-200''' spawns. So just wait for it to kill you.

==Trivia==
* '''GOD-200''' acts like a fail safe, being spawned if the game experiences a fatal error.
* '''GOD-200''' is the replacement for [[Rina]].
* '''GOD-200''' is usually globally spawned by Developers after a huge bug is fixed to reset all servers.
